camel_example: aliyun hbr CreateRestoreJob --region cn-hangzhou --SourceType ECS_FILE --RestoreType ECS_FILE
kebab_example: aliyun hbr create-restore-job --restore-type ECS_FILE --source-type ECS_FILE --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRestoreJob

parameters.help_en:
The data source type of the restore destination. Valid values:
ECS_FILE: Restores data to ECS files.
OSS: Restores data to Alibaba Cloud OSS.
NAS: Restores data to Alibaba Cloud NAS.
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: Restores data to CPFS.
OTS_TABLE: Restores data to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore.
UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK: Restores data to an entire Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
CPFS: Restores data to CPFS (agentless)
parameters.help_zh:
恢复目的地数据源类型，取值范围：
ECS_FILE：恢复到ECS文件。
OSS：恢复到阿里云OSS。
NAS：恢复到阿里云NAS。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：恢复到CPFS。
OTS_TABLE：恢复到阿里云OTS。
UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK：恢复到阿里云ECS整机。
CPFS：恢复到CPFS（无代理）
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.name: snapshot_hash

parameters.help_en:
The data source type. Valid values:
ECS_FILE: Restores ECS files.
OSS: Restores data from Alibaba Cloud OSS.
NAS: Restores data from Alibaba Cloud NAS.
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM: Restores data from CPFS with agent-based backup.
OTS_TABLE: Restores data from Alibaba Cloud Tablestore.
UDM_ECS: Restores data from an entire Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
CPFS: Restores data from CPFS with agentless backup
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值范围：
ECS_FILE：恢复ECS文件。
OSS：恢复阿里云OSS。
NAS：恢复阿里云NAS。
COMMON_FILE_SYSTEM：恢复CPFS有代理备份。
OTS_TABLE：恢复阿里云OTS。
UDM_ECS：恢复阿里云ECS整机。
CPFS：恢复CPFS无代理备份
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The parameters of the restore job
parameters.help_zh: 恢复任务参数
parameters.name: options

parameters.name: target_file_system_id

parameters.help_zh: 仅当RestoreType取值为NAS时，该参数有效。表示恢复目的地的文件系统创建时间。Unix时间戳，单位为秒
parameters.name: target_create_time

parameters.help_en: The file path at the restore destination. This parameter is valid only when RestoreType is set to ECS_FILE

parameters.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket at the restore destination. This parameter is valid only when RestoreType is set to OSS

parameters.name: target_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The details of the full-copy backup. This parameter is valid only when SourceType is set to UDM_ECS. The value is a JSON string. The details to be passed vary based on the value of RestoreType:
UDM_ECS_DISK: ECS cloud disk cloning.
targetInstanceId: string. Required. Instance ID of the destination ECS instance to which the cloned cloud disk is to be mounted.
diskCategory: string. Required. The type of the destination cloud disk.
diskPerformanceLevel: string. The performance level of the cloud disk. This parameter is valid when diskCategory is set to essd. Valid values: PL0, PL1, PL2, and PL3. Default value: PL1.
UDM_ECS_DISK_ROLLBACK: ECS cloud disk restoration.
sourceInstanceId: string. Required. Instance ID of the source ECS instance.
foreceRestore: bool. Default value: false. Specifies whether to force the restoration. If foreceRestore is set to true and the backed-up cloud disk has been unmounted from the original ECS instance or mounted to a new ECS instance, the restore job still restores the cloud disk. Proceed with caution.
bootAfterRestore: bool. Default value: false. Specifies whether to start the ECS instance after the restoration.
UDM_ECS: Entire ECS instance cloning.
bootAfterRestore: bool. Default value: false. Specifies whether to start the ECS instance after the restoration.
diskCategory: string. Required. The type of the destination cloud disk.
diskPerformanceLevel: string. The performance level of the cloud disk. This parameter is valid when diskCategory is set to essd. Valid values: PL0, PL1, PL2, and PL3. Default value: PL1.
instanceType: string. Required. The instance type of the destination ECS instance.
restoredNetwork: string. Required. The vSwitch ID of the destination ECS instance.
securityGroup: string. Required. The security group ID of the destination ECS instance.
restoredName: string. Required. The name of the destination ECS instance.
restoredHostName: string. Required. The hostname of the destination ECS instance.
allocatePublicIp: bool. Default value: false. Specifies whether to assign a public IP address to the destination ECS instance.
privateIpAddress: string. The internal IP address of the destination ECS instance. If this parameter is not specified, an IP address is randomly assigned by using DHCP.
UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK: Entire ECS instance restoration.
sourceInstanceId: string. Required. Instance ID of the source ECS instance.
forceRestore: bool. Default value: false. Specifies whether to force the restoration. If forceRestore is set to true and the backed-up cloud disk has been unmounted from the original ECS instance or mounted to a new ECS instance, the restore job still restores the cloud disk. Proceed with caution.
bootAfterRestore: bool. Default value: false. Specifies whether to start the ECS instance after the restoration
parameters.help_zh:
仅当SourceType取值为UDM_ECS时，该参数有效。表示整机备份详情。该参数为JSON字符串，根据RestoreType取值不同，该参数需传入的详情信息如下：
UDM_ECS_DISK: ECS云盘克隆。
targetInstanceId: string类型，必填，表示克隆出来的云盘需要挂载的目标ECS实例ID。
diskCategory: string类型，必填，表示目标云盘类型。
diskPerformanceLevel: string类型，当diskCategory=essd时，表示云盘性能等级，支持PL0、PL1、PL2和PL3，默认PL1。
UDM_ECS_DISK_ROLLBACK:  ECS云盘恢复。
sourceInstanceId: string类型，必填，表示源ECS实例ID。
foreceRestore: bool类型，默认值为false，表示是否强制恢复。当foreceRestore=true时，如果备份的云盘已经从原ECS实例卸载，或挂载到新的ECS实例，恢复任务仍然会进行云盘恢复，请谨慎操作。
bootAfterRestore: bool类型，默认值为false，表示恢复后是否启动ECS实例。
UDM_ECS: ECS整机克隆。
bootAfterRestore: bool类型，默认值为false，表示恢复后是否启动ECS实例。
diskCategory: string类型，必填，表示目标云盘类型。
diskPerformanceLevel: string类型，当diskCategory=essd时，表示云盘性能等级，支持PL0、PL1、PL2和PL3，默认PL1。
instanceType: string类型，必填，表示目标ECS实例规格。
restoredNetwork: string类型，必填，表示目标ECS实例的虚拟交换机ID。
securityGroup: string类型，必填，表示目标ECS实例的安全组ID。
restoredName: string类型，必填，表示目标ECS实例的实例名称。
restoredHostName: string类型，必填，表示目标ECS实例的主机名称。
allocatePublicIp: bool类型，默认值为false，表示目标ECS实例是否分配公网IP。
privateIpAddress: string类型，表示目标ECS实例的内网IP，如果未指定，将使用DHCP随机分配。
UDM_ECS_ROLLBACK: ECS整机恢复。
sourceInstanceId: string类型，必填，表示源ECS实例ID。
forceRestore: bool类型，默认值为false，表示是否强制恢复。当foreceRestore=true时，如果备份的云盘已经从原ECS实例卸载，或挂载到新的ECS实例，恢复任务仍然会进行云盘恢复，请谨慎操作。
bootAfterRestore: bool类型，默认值为false，表示恢复后是否启动ECS实例
